title: Peanut Butter Balls
description: Simple balls of peanut butter and icing sugar, dipped in dark chocolate. A healthy-ish treat that uses up storecupboard ingredients.
steps: Sift the icing sugar into a bowl and slowly add the peanut butter. Bring together with your hands. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll into 50p-sized balls between your palms. Place on greaseproof paper and chill for another 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate in a heatproof bowl over boiling water or in the microwave. Allow to cool slightly.
Dip the balls one by one in chocolate until fully covered. Allow excess to drip off and place on a wire rack to harden.
